spells.name: Hand-Tailed Drag
spells.story: A dog-like water beast with a hand on its tail, who pulls bathers under.

spells.name: Lake Salamander
spells.story: A salamander of the lake who never grew up, and grows back every limb.

spells.name: Hailstone Cat
spells.story: A grey cat of the mountains that sends hail on the crops when its eyes flash.

spells.name: Spring-Sprite's Prank
spells.story: A small guardian of the water and woods who leads wanderers astray and takes a fright from them.

spells.name: Eagle Dive
spells.story: A warrior of the eagle order in a feathered suit and a beaked helm, who dives on his foe.

spells.name: Jaguar Pelt Charge
spells.story: A warrior of the jaguar order in a spotted pelt and a wooden helm, who charges with a macuahuitl.

spells.name: Messenger's Burden
spells.story: Another owl messenger of the lords of Xibalba, who carries the summons.

spells.name: Owl's Message
spells.story: One of the owl messengers of Xibalba, who calls the heroes to the lords.

spells.name: Omen Hoot
spells.story: The owl whose hoot at night was a bad omen in the old city, and the fighter feels it.

spells.name: Opossum's Ember
spells.story: The opossum who stole fire for the people and carries the scorched tail.

spells.name: Two-Headed Serpent
spells.story: A two-headed serpent of the Andes with a head at each end, which coils round the mountain.

spells.name: Death Bat's Dive
spells.story: The bat of the House of Bats in Xibalba, who dives out of the dark at the young heroes.

spells.name: Chanka Sling
spells.source: Cieza de Leon, Chronicle of Peru
spells.story: A warrior of the Chanka nation who slings stones from the ridge and marches on Cusco.

spells.name: Wild Archer's Volley
spells.story: A hunter of the northern plains who never farmed and never missed.

spells.name: Shorn One's Vow
spells.story: A Mexica captain who shaved his head and swore never to retreat in battle.

spells.boss_name: Itzcuintli the Dog of the Dead
spells.name: Dog's Guide
spells.story: The dog who carries the dead across the river to the nine-fold land.

spells.name: Shape-Shifter's Turn
spells.story: A sorcerer who changes into a beast and back again in the dark.

spells.name: Forest Mother's Coil
spells.story: A great snake that lies still in the forest until moss grows on her back, then strikes.

spells.name: Owl-Man's Spell
spells.story: A sorcerer who takes the owl's shape at night to spoil the hearth.

spells.name: Water Mother's Wave
spells.story: A huge serpent of the river that swallows boats and the waterside.

spells.name: Gathering of Blood
spells.story: A lord of Xibalba whose power was over the blood of the living, and sickened the heroes.

spells.name: Raking Claws
spells.story: A lord of Xibalba, named for his claws, who rakes at travellers on the road.

spells.name: Hungry Teeth
spells.story: A lord of Xibalba, named for his teeth, who bites at the heroes on the road.

spells.name: Bone Rod
spells.story: A lord of Xibalba who wields a staff of bone and strikes the traveller thin.

spells.name: Cloud Warrior's Sling
spells.source: Cieza de Leon, Chronicle of Peru
spells.story: A warrior of the cloud forest, whose fortress stands above the mist.

spells.name: Crossroads Wail
spells.story: The spirits of women who died in childbirth, who haunt the crossroads at night.

spells.name: Scab Sickness
spells.story: A lord of Xibalba who made men break out in sores, and blighted the travellers.

spells.name: Yellow Sickness
spells.story: A lord of Xibalba who turns the skin yellow and brings jaundice.

spells.name: Pus Swelling
spells.story: A lord of Xibalba who swells the limbs of the living with pus.

spells.name: Skull Rod
spells.story: A lord of Xibalba who wields a staff topped by a skull.

spells.name: House of Bats
spells.story: The house of bats, with Camazotz at the centre, where the heroes were pressed to the floor.

spells.name: House of Cold
spells.story: The house of cold where hail comes down and freezes the unwary.

spells.name: House of Dark
spells.story: The first house of the trial, where the torch and the cigars were given to be returned whole.

spells.name: House of Fire
spells.story: The house of fire where the heroes were put to burn, and came out whole.

spells.name: Canopy Strike
spells.story: The great eagle of the rainforest that hunts monkeys and sloths in the canopy.

spells.name: House of Jaguars
spells.story: The house where jaguars crowd the room and press upon the heroes.

spells.name: Runner's Messenger
spells.story: A runner of the Moche painted in the pots, who carries a bag of beans over the desert.

spells.name: Night Jaguar
spells.story: A sorcerer in the shape of a jaguar who hunts in the dark.

spells.name: House of Knives
spells.story: The house where the knives talk among themselves and cut whoever steps in.

spells.name: Dark Llama's Star
spells.story: A llama in the dark nebula of the Milky Way, who drinks the rivers.

spells.name: Conqueror's Spear
spells.story: The Inca prince of the early chronicles who won the lands of the south.

spells.name: Four Hundred Southerners
spells.story: The four hundred brothers who were born with hatred and attacked at Coatepec.

spells.name: Giantess's Pride
spells.story: The wife of Seven Macaw and mother of the giants, who stood by her proud husband.

spells.name: Warlord's Conquest
spells.story: A Mixtec warlord of the codices who conquered many towns and rose to rule Tilantongo.

spells.name: Conqueror's Leap
spells.story: The Maya lord who took Chichen Itza's power and went on to rule at Mayapan.

spells.name: Obsidian Serpent
spells.story: The Mexica ruler who broke the tyrant Maxtla and made the Triple Alliance.

spells.name: Bolas Throw
spells.source: Cieza de Leon, Chronicle of Peru
spells.story: A legendary Inca ancestress who flung her bolas and won her battles.

spells.name: Tyrant's Hand
spells.story: The Tepanec lord who killed a king and held the valley in fear.

spells.name: Falling Stars
spells.story: A star-demon that was said to fall at an eclipse and eat the people.

spells.name: General's Advance
spells.source: Cieza de Leon, Chronicle of Peru
spells.story: The Chanka general who marched on Cusco and nearly took the city.

spells.name: Mountain-Shaker
spells.story: The younger son of Seven Macaw, who shook the mountains and levelled them.

spells.name: Fire Eater
spells.story: The fire-giant of the old Yauyos mountains, who ate the children and who was driven out.

spells.name: Fasting Coyote
spells.story: The poet-king of Texcoco, who built the gardens and wrote the songs; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Giants' Landing
spells.source: Cieza de Leon, Chronicle of Peru / Garcilaso
spells.story: Giants said to have landed on the coast of Ecuador, who dug wells in the rock and were burned from the sky.

spells.name: False Sun
spells.story: The proud bird-lord who claimed to be the sun and moon, and shot down by the twin hero.

spells.name: Stabbing Master's Thrust
spells.story: A lord of Xibalba who stabs those who pass, and is quick with the point.

spells.name: Filth Heap
spells.story: A lord of Xibalba whose domain is the sweepings, he buries travellers in filth.

spells.name: Counsel from the Shadow
spells.story: The counsellor who stood behind four Mexica rulers and rewrote their history.

spells.name: Fire Serpent's Strike
spells.story: The turquoise fire serpent, the weapon of the sun's war-band.

spells.name: Mountain-Raiser
spells.story: The elder son of Seven Macaw, who raised the mountains in a night.

spells.name: Winged Brother's Flight
spells.story: The Inca founder-brother who grew wings and flew to a hilltop to turn to stone.

spells.name: Mountain-Splitting Sling
spells.story: The Inca founder-brother whose sling split the hills, and who was sealed in a cave.

spells.name: Brother Turned to Stone
spells.story: The Inca founder-brother who sat on the sacred hill and became a stone.

spells.name: Rubber Ball Strike
spells.story: A champion of the ball game, who struck the heavy rubber ball with his hip.

spells.name: Earth Crocodile
spells.story: The great crocodile of the first waters, from whom the earth was made.

spells.name: Wolf Order's Charge
spells.story: A warrior of the wolf order in a pelt and a wooden helm, who runs at the foe in a pack.

spells.name: Highland Conquest
spells.story: The great K'iche' king, who is named in the Popol Vuh as winning the highlands.

spells.name: Cloud Serpents
spells.story: The cloud-serpents, the first hunters, who were shot down by the sky.

spells.name: Hunter's Cloud-Arrow
spells.story: A hunter of the northern plains who follows the cloud-serpents with a bow.

spells.name: Otomi Sling
spells.story: A fierce warrior of the Otomi, who fought in front of the Mexica line with a sling.

spells.name: Water-Face's Charge
spells.story: The Mexica tlatoani who beat Tlatelolco and led armies west.

spells.name: Bird Jaguar's Spear
spells.story: A king of Yaxchilan, who recorded his captures on the lintels.

spells.name: Roca's Schools
spells.source: Cieza de Leon, Chronicle of Peru
spells.story: The sixth Inca of the old chronicles, who founded the first school in Cusco and conquered the nearby valleys.

spells.name: Chimu King's Gold
spells.source: Cieza de Leon, Chronicle of Peru
spells.story: The last independent king of the Chimu, who ruled the coast from Chan Chan.

spells.name: Arrow at the Sky
spells.story: The fifth Mexica ruler, who shot an arrow into the sky; he died in 1469, and the player faces a king of the old city.

spells.name: Earth-Shaker's Order
spells.source: Cieza de Leon, Chronicle of Peru
spells.story: The Inca who turned a small kingdom into an empire and rebuilt Cusco.

spells.name: Conquering March
spells.source: Cieza de Leon, Chronicle of Peru
spells.story: The Inca who marched down the coast and conquered the Chimu.

spells.name: Eighteen Images
spells.story: The thirteenth king of Copan, whose reign of the eighth century raised the great plaza.

spells.boss_name: K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo of Copan
spells.name: Green Quetzal Macaw
spells.story: The founder of the Copan dynasty in the fifth century, who came from the west with a quetzal-feathered banner.

spells.name: Snake Kingdom's Reach
spells.story: A king of the Snake Kingdom in the sixth century, who held the great alliance against Tikal.

spells.name: Dice with Tlaloc
spells.story: The last Toltec king, whose pride and gambling are said to have ruined Tula.

spells.name: Howler's Trick
spells.story: The elder half-brother of the Hero Twins, who was tricked into a monkey's shape.

spells.name: One Death
spells.story: The first lord of Xibalba, who sits on his throne and sends the first lord's trials.

spells.name: Howler's Song
spells.story: The other elder half-brother of the Hero Twins, who plays the flute and makes everyone laugh.

spells.name: Blowgun Shot
spells.story: The elder Hero Twin, who shot down Seven Macaw and outplayed the lords; the player stands against a champion.

spells.name: Tikal's Victory
spells.story: The Tikal king who broke Calakmul's power and restored his city.

spells.name: Queen's Rule
spells.story: The queen of Naranjo who ruled for her young son and carried her city to power.

spells.name: Palenque's Long Reign
spells.story: The long-lived king of Palenque, who built the Temple of the Inscriptions; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Seven Death
spells.story: The second lord of Xibalba, who rules beside One Death over the underworld.

spells.name: Jaguar Sun
spells.story: The younger Hero Twin, who outwitted the lords of Xibalba; an honourable foe.

spells.name: Skull Tree
spells.story: The tree in Xibalba where the father of the Hero Twins hung, and whose fruit spoke to a maiden.

spells.name: Seven Caves
spells.story: The seven caves from which the peoples of the valley said they had emerged.

spells.name: Serpent Mountain
spells.story: The Serpent Mountain where the Four Hundred were beaten, and the mountain shakes.

spells.name: Omen of the Island
spells.story: The eagle on the prickly pear that showed the Mexica where to build.

spells.name: Golden Staff
spells.story: The Inca founder of the old legend, who struck the golden staff into the earth at Cusco.

spells.name: Nine Rivers
spells.story: The land of the dead with its nine levels and rivers, which the dead cross on their long journey.

spells.name: Giant's Fall
spells.story: The race of giants said to have lived before, who were broken by the later peoples.

spells.name: Lost Garden
spells.story: The place of the broken tree where the flowers fell and the first people were born.

spells.name: Lake's Cold Rise
spells.story: The lake of the valley where the island city stood, rising cold and still.

spells.name: Underworld's Road
spells.story: The underworld of the Popol Vuh, with its rivers and crossing roads, where the traveller must choose.
